name: Pre-flight checks
calls: runner checks: UTC day, fault_monitor_runs, AlanSharedResourcesAutoSync task, Schema Tools/scripts/faq-layout-fixtures.mjs, .env key names, GET https://www.alanranger.com/
success: not Monday UTC; no ① in progress; auto-sync paused; FAQ fixture gate passes; secrets present; site returns 200
dry_run: same checks; Monday / ① running / auto-sync on are warnings instead of hard fails

name: Build CSVs 01–05, 08 and raw-01
calls: Schema Tools scripts/csv-builders: fetch-feeds.mjs + fetch-event-items.mjs + fetch-commerce-products.mjs (paced, GET only) → build-exact.mjs (feeds → 01–05, 08) + build-raw01-api.mjs (hidden categories carried forward by default) + byte-compare.mjs
success: every file written; header/BOM/EOL identical to the previous export
dry_run: fresh read-only fetch into a sandbox copy of the feed cache (shared cache untouched); writes into the sandbox csv folder only

name: Preliminary ingest (steps 1–4) + mappings export
calls: Chat AI Bot api/csv-import.js (step 1) → api/ingest.js (step 2) → api/admin?action=refresh (step 3) → api/tools?action=finalize (step 4) → api/tools?action=export (writes 05-event-product-mappings-latest.csv); live: the same deployed endpoints with Bearer INGEST_TOKEN (runner/ingest-live.mjs)
dry_run: real handlers against the recording mock over a production snapshot (no database writes); step 2 scrapes a 3-URL paced sample; export written to the sandbox and compared with the live 05

name: Reviews: Google fetch, frozen Trustpilot, lock + merge, hold list
calls: Schema Tools scripts/fetch-google-reviews.py (Google Business Profile API, free) + scripts/merge-reviews.py (includes shadow matcher) + scripts/reconcile-combined-vs-db.py
success: frozen Trustpilot guard passes; new Google reviews held for Alan
dry_run: read-only Google fetch into the sandbox (OAuth files copied in for the fetch, then removed); merge runs in the sandbox; the note reconciles combined vs DB

name: Product schema + 07
calls: Schema Tools scripts/clean-products-csv.py → scripts/generate-product-schema.py --write-07 → check-review-dates.py, check-product-review-homes.py
success: all products generated; review dates and homes guards pass; FAQ unknown = 0
dry_run: SCHEMA_TOOLS_DRY_RUN=1 in the sandbox (no tool-run-report POST); page fetches are paced

name: Event Posts + hub FAQs
calls: Schema Tools scripts/app-cli.mjs event-posts (the app's own generateEventPostBundle + deployEventPostBundle, headless)
success: every event in 02/03 has a schema file
dry_run: output into the sandbox, then app-cli-compare.mjs against alanranger-schema (run dates ignored)

name: Blog index
calls: Schema Tools scripts/app-cli.mjs blog-index (the app's own generateBlogIndexSchema + exportAndDeployBlogSchema, headless)
dry_run: output into the sandbox, then compared with alanranger-schema (run dates ignored)

name: Blog posts — new or changed only
calls: runner: blog feed body hash + 01 row hash vs outputs/schema/blogs-manifest.json → scripts/bulk-regen-blog-howto-faq.mjs --csv=<changed list> (live, paced)
success: only new posts or posts whose body / 01 row changed regenerate; an updatedOn bump alone is held
dry_run: lists the posts that would regenerate (against the last 01 export until blogs-manifest.json exists; the first live run regenerates those, then writes the manifest); builds the manifest in the sandbox; no regeneration
duration: seconds dry; minutes per changed post live

name: Landing pages
calls: Schema Tools scripts/app-cli.mjs landings (the app's own regenerateAllLandingPages + deployLandingHostedSchemas, headless)
success: every hosted landing page has a schema file
dry_run: business rating built from product_reviews, then the generator runs into the sandbox; every difference against the hosted files is listed with its live source (landing-diff-explain.json). Report-only in LIVE until approved

name: Deploy + CDN wait + sample live checks
success: manifest on the CDN shows the new generatedAt; sample pages return 200
dry_run: counts the files that would change in alanranger-schema; no copy, commit or push; samples the CDN read-only

name: Final ingest
calls: Chat AI Bot api/csv-import.js (incl. product_schema from the new 07)
dry_run: recording mock again, now including the sandbox 07

name: Export 09 keywords
dry_run: reads the DB row count only; writes nothing

name: ① Full audit → broken links → ② score
calls: AI GEO Audit POST /api/aigeo/traditional-seo-render {action:'start', source:'trad_seo'}; the */5 trad-seo-render-tick cron advances render then broken links; runner polls GET ?runId (fault_monitor_runs)
success: run done and every page broken-link checked
dry_run: simulated (no requests); Monday / already-running checks still evaluated. Untick "Include full audit (①)" on the page to skip it ("skipped — not selected"); the Monday ① runs either way
